PDF Optimizing GPU Volume Rendering - Danny Ruijters
ABSTRACT Volume Rendering methods employing the GPU capabilities offer high performance on off-the-shelf hardware. In this article, we discuss the various bottlenecks found in the graphics hardware when performing GPU-based Volume Rendering.
